values.other: CDA 510; NES 838; DEF STAN 02-838; BS 2870/2875 'Superceded by BSEN 1652, BSEN 1653 and BSEN 1654 (1998)'

printed.verbatim_row: Phosphor Bronze PB 102 (UNS C51000) ... Specifications: UNS C51000 and UNS C54400 | CDA 510 | ISO CuSn5 | CW451K | NES 838 and DEF STAN 02-838

grades.disagreements: Round 2: Aircraft Materials agrees with Aalco on CW451K / C51000 / CuSn5 for PB102. Aircraft Materials also lists UNS C54400 under PB102; C54400 is a leaded free-machining phosphor bronze (Cu-Sn-Pb-Zn), so treat it as the source's broader grouping, not an equivalent.

printed.verbatim_row: CA104 Technical Datasheet ... Related material specifications: CW307G | BS B23 | DTD197A ; 'usually compared with BS1400 AB2 when a cast alternative is acceptable'
C63000 Technical Datasheet ... Related material specifications: AMS4640 | CW307G | CA104
EN CuAl10Ni5Fe4 / CW307G ; Internal alloy name: CW307G ; EN: CuAl10Ni5Fe4 ; UNS: C63000 ; SIS: - ; GB: - ; JIS: -

grades.disagreements: Round 2: Smiths (two datasheets) and Alumeco agree with Aalco's table on CA104 = CW307G; Smiths' C63000 sheet and Alumeco both give UNS C63000. Alumeco prints the JIS field as '-' (no JIS equivalent given).

printed.verbatim_row: C101 ... Related material specifications: C11000 ETP | BS1433 | BS13601 CW004A | Cu-ETP | DIN 2.0060

grades.disagreements: Round 2: Smiths' C101 sheet prints CW004A, agreeing with Aalco's datasheet rather than the 'CR004A' in Aalco's conversion table. Smiths prints 'BS13601', which reads as a typo for BS EN 13601 (recorded as printed).

printed.verbatim_row: CC491K (LG2) Bar & Castings ... Related Specifications: BS1400 LG2 | CuSn5Zn5Pb5-C | C83600

grades.disagreements: Round 2: Smiths and Righton Blackburns both print LG2 = CC491K. Only Righton prints the EN name (CuSn5Zn5Pb5-C) and UNS C83600. Righton's text is not the Aalco text here (Aalco has no LG2 sheet in this data).

printed.verbatim_row: 2.1247 - CuBe2 / CW101C / C17200 ; Material 2.1247, also known as CuBe2, CW101C or C17200.
CW101C - Copper beryllium / CuBe2 / C17200 ; Material CW101C, also referred to as CuBe2 or C17200, is a high-strength copper-beryllium alloy ...

grades.disagreements: Round 2 (first data): Studer-Biennaform and Jacques Allemann (both Swiss) agree CW101C = CuBe2 = C17200; Studer also prints W.-Nr. 2.1247. The two sites share a page template ('- Werkstoffe -' titles) but the wording differs, so they are counted as separate publishers.

printed.verbatim_row: Cu-OF ; Standard designations: EN CW008A / UNS C10200
EN Cu-OF / CW008A ; Internal alloy name: CW008A ; EN: EN Cu-OF ; UNS: C10200 ; SS: 5011 ; GB: TU0.008 / C10800 ; JIS: - ; Also known as: -

grades.disagreements: Round 2: KEMPER and Alumeco both print CW008A = Cu-OF = UNS C10200, against Aalco's conversion-table 'CR008A' (a refinery-shape number). Neither prints an old BS number, so the link to C103 (or Aalco's C104) is still unconfirmed. Alumeco's GB field prints 'TU0.008 / C10800'; that C10800 differs from the C10200 in its own UNS field (recorded as printed).
Round 2: Smiths prints C106 = CW024A (BS EN 13601) = C12200 = Cu-DHP, agreeing with Aalco's datasheet rather than Aalco's table ('CR024A').

printed.verbatim_row: CZ108 (CW508L) ... Related Material Specifications: CW508L | CZ108 | C27200 | CuZn37

grades.disagreements: Round 2: Smiths agrees with Aalco: CZ108 = CW508L = C27200 = CuZn37.

printed.verbatim_row: CZ114 (CW721R) ... Related Material Specifications: Corresponds to UNS C67500.

grades.disagreements: Round 2: Smiths agrees with Aalco's datasheet: CZ114 = CW721R = UNS C67500. Aalco's conversion table also names CW722R for CZ114; Smiths does not.
